grammar.pattern: 并且 / 不光 / 不仅 / 另外 / 要是 / 因此 / 由于 / 只有
grammar.purpose: Connect clauses according to their relationship
grammar.explanation: 并且 adds a connected statement; 不光/不仅 introduce the first part of an additive pair with 还/也/而且. 另外 adds a separate point. 要是 introduces an if-condition, commonly answered by 就. 由于 introduces the cause clause and 因此 the consequence; here 由于……，因此…… links two clauses, contrasting the earlier preposition plus cause phrase. 只有 names a necessary condition with 才. Do not interchange cause, addition and condition just because all link statements.

examples.zh: 先确认地点，并且问清费用；另外，还要问人数。
examples.py: xiān què rèn dì diǎn , bìng qiě wèn qīng fèi yòng ; lìng wài , hái yào wèn rén shù .
examples.en: Confirm the venue and expenses; additionally ask the number of people.

examples.zh: 不光要问时间，还要问地点；不仅要公布，也要解释清楚。
examples.py: bù guāng yào wèn shí jiān , hái yào wèn dì diǎn ; bù jǐn yào gōng bù , yě yào jiě shì qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Ask not only the time but the venue; not only announce it but explain clearly.

examples.zh: 要是下雨，就换室内；由于场地没批准，因此先不公布。
examples.py: yào shì xià yǔ , jiù huàn shì nèi ; yóu yú chǎng dì méi pī zhǔn , yīn cǐ xiān bù gōng bù .
examples.en: If it rains, move indoors; because the venue is unapproved, do not announce yet.

examples.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù .

commonMistakes.wrong: 要是大家同意，因此大家同意。
commonMistakes.right: 要是大家同意，就再确认场地。
commonMistakes.why: An if-condition does not assert its own fulfillment; give the corresponding next action.

grammar.purpose: Name a necessary, not sufficient, condition
grammar.explanation: 只有大家同意才公布 sets agreement as necessary for announcing. It does not say agreement alone makes a venue available or forces an announcement. Contrast 要是大家同意，就再确认场地, an if-then step. 不同意就不公布 is compatible with the necessary condition; 同意了还要确认场地 is also compatible. Keep the stated condition and remaining requirements distinct.

examples.zh: 只有大家同意，才公布新安排。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu dà jiā tóng yì , cái gōng bù xīn ān pái .
examples.en: Only if everyone agrees will the new arrangements be announced.

examples.zh: 只有确认场地，才可以发地址。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu què rèn chǎng dì , cái kě yǐ fā dì zhǐ .
examples.en: Only after confirming the venue may the address be sent.

examples.zh: 大家同意了，还要等场地批准。
examples.py: dà jiā tóng yì le , hái yào děng chǎng dì pī zhǔn .
examples.en: Everyone has agreed; venue approval is still needed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 只有大家同意才公布，所以同意以后一定立刻公布。
commonMistakes.right: 大家同意以后，还要确认其他要求，再公布。
commonMistakes.why: A necessary condition alone does not guarantee immediate action.

lines.en: I can't on Friday; I'm working late. Would Saturday work?

lines.py: wǒ wèn wèn tā . nǐ xiǎng chī shén me ?

lines.py: hǎo zhǔ yì . yào shì tā lái , wǒ zuò sān gè rén de .
lines.en: Good idea. If she comes, I'll cook for three.

lines.zh: 她上次说不能吃很辣的，别忘了。
lines.py: tā shàng cì shuō bù néng chī hěn là de , bié wàng le .

lines.zh: 那辣的放旁边，自己加。
lines.py: nà là de fàng páng biān , zì jǐ jiā .
lines.en: We can put the chilli on the side and add it ourselves.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我同意。只有你自己吃的那碗，才可以全放进去。
lines.py: wǒ tóng yì . zhǐ yǒu nǐ zì jǐ chī de nà wǎn , cái kě yǐ quán fàng jìn qù .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你反对我的做法？
lines.py: nǐ fǎn duì wǒ de zuò fǎ ?
lines.en: You object to my cooking?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我反对把我的面条变成一碗辣椒。
lines.py: wǒ fǎn duì bǎ wǒ de miàn tiáo biàn chéng yī wǎn là jiāo .
lines.en: I object to my noodles becoming a bowl of chilli.

lines.zh: 行，我周六下午买菜，你带饮料。

lines.py: hǎo , bìng qiě wǒ huì dài yī gè néng chī fàn de zuǐ .

reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.

lines.zh: 我想周五请朋友来做饭，陈宇却要加班。他提议改到周六，我问过小周以后，三个人都同意了。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhōu wǔ qǐng péng you lái zuò fàn , chén yǔ què yào jiā bān . tā tí yì gǎi dào zhōu liù , wǒ wèn guò xiǎo zhōu yǐ hòu , sān gè rén dōu tóng yì le .
lines.en: I wanted friends over to cook on Friday, but Chen Yu had to work late. He suggested Saturday. After I checked with Xiao Zhou, all three of us agreed.

lines.zh: 小周说只要不太辣，她就很想吃面条。我平时爱吃辣，原来打算把辣椒直接放进锅里，这次先把它留在一只小碗里。
lines.py: xiǎo zhōu shuō zhǐ yào bù tài là , tā jiù hěn xiǎng chī miàn tiáo . wǒ píng shí ài chī là , yuán lái dǎ suàn bǎ là jiāo zhí jiē fàng jìn guō lǐ , zhè cì xiān bǎ tā liú zài yī zhǐ xiǎo wǎn lǐ .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou wanted noodles as long as they were not too spicy. I usually like chilli in the pot, but this time I kept it in a small bowl.

lines.zh: 周六下午，我买了面条和蔬菜，并且提前洗好三个碗。陈宇带来饮料，还带了一个大碗，说小碗恐怕不够他吃。
lines.py: zhōu liù xià wǔ , wǒ mǎi le miàn tiáo hé shū cài , bìng qiě tí qián xǐ hǎo sān gè wǎn . chén yǔ dài lái yǐn liào , hái dài le yī gè dà wǎn , shuō xiǎo wǎn kǒng pà bù gòu tā chī .
lines.en: On Saturday afternoon I bought noodles and vegetables and washed three bowls in advance. Chen Yu brought drinks and a large bowl, saying a small one might not be enough.

lines.zh: 面条煮好以后，小周先尝了一口，说这样正好。我给自己的那碗加了辣椒，陈宇加了一点，又赶紧拿饮料。
lines.py: miàn tiáo zhǔ hǎo yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu xiān cháng le yī kǒu , shuō zhè yàng zhèng hǎo . wǒ gěi zì jǐ de nà wǎn jiā le là jiāo , chén yǔ jiā le yī diǎn , yòu gǎn jǐn ná yǐn liào .
lines.en: Once the noodles were ready, Xiao Zhou tasted hers and said they were just right. I added chilli to my bowl. Chen Yu tried a little and quickly reached for his drink.

lines.zh: 我们一边吃一边看节目。好笑的地方来了，陈宇差点把饮料放进我的碗里，说下次只有他自己吃的那碗，才可以离饮料这么近。
lines.py: wǒ men yī biān chī yī biān kàn jié mù . hǎo xiào de dì fāng lái le , chén yǔ chà diǎn bǎ yǐn liào fàng jìn wǒ de wǎn lǐ , shuō xià cì zhǐ yǒu tā zì jǐ chī de nà wǎn , cái kě yǐ lí yǐn liào zhè me jìn .
lines.en: We ate while watching a show. At a funny moment Chen Yu nearly put his drink in my bowl. He said next time only his own bowl should be that close to his drink.

lines.zh: 吃完以后，小周帮我洗碗，陈宇把剩下的饮料收好。三个人商量，下次去他家，他说可以，但先别期待他也能做饭。
lines.py: chī wán yǐ hòu , xiǎo zhōu bāng wǒ xǐ wǎn , chén yǔ bǎ shèng xià de yǐn liào shōu hǎo . sān gè rén shāng liáng , xià cì qù tā jiā , tā shuō kě yǐ , dàn xiān bié qī dài tā yě néng zuò fàn .
lines.en: After eating, Xiao Zhou helped wash up and Chen Yu put away the drinks. We agreed to meet at his place next time. He said yes, but asked us not to expect him to cook too.

choices: They share noodles, watch a show and clean up
questions.answer: They share noodles, watch a show and clean up

lines.en: We ate while watching a show. At a funny moment Chen Yu nearly put his drink in my bowl. He said next time only his own bowl should be that close to his drink.

lines.zh: 他买了菜，并且洗好了碗。
lines.py: tā mǎi le cài , bìng qiě xǐ hǎo le wǎn .

lines.zh: 她会唱歌，并且会弹琴。
lines.py: tā huì chàng gē , bìng qiě huì dàn qín .
lines.en: She can sing and play an instrument.

lines.zh: 不光我喜欢，弟弟也喜欢。
lines.py: bù guāng wǒ xǐ huān , dì di yě xǐ huān .
lines.en: My younger brother likes it as well as me.

lines.zh: 这家店不光卖书，还卖咖啡。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn bù guāng mài shū , hái mài kā fēi .
lines.en: This shop sells coffee as well as books.

lines.zh: 她不仅来了，还带了朋友。
lines.py: tā bù jǐn lái le , hái dài le péng you .
lines.en: She came and brought a friend too.

lines.zh: 他不仅会做饭，还会做蛋糕。
lines.py: tā bù jǐn huì zuò fàn , hái huì zuò dàn gāo .
lines.en: He can make cakes as well as cook.

lines.zh: 要是下雨，我们就坐车。
lines.py: yào shì xià yǔ , wǒ men jiù zuò chē .
lines.en: If it rains, we'll take a bus.

lines.zh: 要是你有空，就来喝茶吧。
lines.py: yào shì nǐ yǒu kōng , jiù lái hē chá ba .
lines.en: If you're free, come over for tea.

lines.zh: 只有把门关好，屋里才暖和。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu bǎ mén guān hǎo , wū lǐ cái nuǎn huo .
lines.en: The room only stays warm if the door is properly shut.

lines.zh: 只有周六我才有空。
lines.py: zhǐ yǒu zhōu liù wǒ cái yǒu kōng .
lines.en: I'm only free on Saturday.

lines.zh: 爸爸同意我周末出去玩。
lines.py: bà bà tóng yì wǒ zhōu mò chū qù wán .
lines.en: My father agreed to let me go out at the weekend.

lines.zh: 我们都同意先吃饭。
lines.py: wǒ men dōu tóng yì xiān chī fàn .
lines.en: We all agreed to eat first.

lines.zh: 我反对把旧树砍掉。
lines.py: wǒ fǎn duì bǎ jiù shù kǎn diào .
lines.en: I object to cutting down the old tree.

lines.zh: 她没有反对，只是问了一下费用。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu fǎn duì , zhǐ shì wèn le yī xià fèi yòng .
lines.en: She did not object; she just asked about the cost.

lines.zh: 他坚决不肯换座位。
lines.py: tā jiān jué bù kěn huàn zuò wèi .
lines.en: He firmly refused to change seats.

lines.zh: 妈妈坚决反对我晚上一个人去。
lines.py: mā mā jiān jué fǎn duì wǒ wǎn shang yī gè rén qù .
lines.en: My mother strongly opposed my going alone at night.

lines.zh: 她主张先修好屋顶。
lines.py: tā zhǔ zhāng xiān xiū hǎo wū dǐng .
lines.en: She advocated repairing the roof first.

lines.zh: 我主张把时间留给大家提问。
lines.py: wǒ zhǔ zhāng bǎ shí jiān liú gěi dà jiā tí wèn .
lines.en: I suggest leaving time for everyone's questions.

lines.zh: 你有什么好主意？
lines.py: nǐ yǒu shén me hǎo zhǔ yì ?
lines.en: Have you got a good idea?

lines.zh: 这个主意是小周提的。
lines.py: zhè gè zhǔ yì shì xiǎo zhōu tí de .
lines.en: Xiao Zhou suggested this idea.

lines.zh: 学校制定了新的时间表。
lines.py: xué xiào zhì dìng le xīn de shí jiān biǎo .
lines.en: The school drew up a new timetable.

lines.zh: 我们先制定旅行计划。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān zhì dìng lǚ xíng jì huà .
lines.en: Let's draw up a travel plan first.

lines.zh: 公司改了休假制度。
lines.py: gōng sī gǎi le xiū jià zhì dù .
lines.en: The company changed its leave system.

lines.zh: 这项制度已经用了十年。
lines.py: zhè xiàng zhì dù yǐ jīng yòng le shí nián .
lines.en: This system has been used for ten years.

lines.zh: 老师说我的书写越来越规范。
lines.py: lǎo shī shuō wǒ de shū xiě yuè lái yuè guī fàn .
lines.en: The teacher says my handwriting is becoming more standard.

lines.zh: 这家公司有完整的服务规范。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī yǒu wán zhěng de fú wù guī fàn .
lines.en: This company has a complete set of service standards.

lines.zh: 这家公司的经营是合法的。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de jīng yíng shì hé fǎ de .
lines.en: This company operates legally.

lines.zh: 他问这份合同是否合法。
lines.py: tā wèn zhè fèn hé tóng shì fǒu hé fǎ .
lines.en: He asked whether this contract was legal.

lines.zh: 学校批准了我们的申请。
lines.py: xué xiào pī zhǔn le wǒ men de shēn qǐng .
lines.en: The school approved our application.

lines.zh: 这个项目还没有得到批准。
lines.py: zhè gè xiàng mù hái méi yǒu dé dào pī zhǔn .
lines.en: This project has not yet been approved.

lines.zh: 她的设计得到了大家的认可。
lines.py: tā de shè jì dé dào le dà jiā de rèn kě .
lines.en: Everyone approved of her design.

lines.zh: 老师认可了我的修改。
lines.py: lǎo shī rèn kě le wǒ de xiū gǎi .
lines.en: The teacher accepted my revisions.

lines.zh: 出门前，他确保窗户都关好了。
lines.py: chū mén qián , tā què bǎo chuāng hù dōu guān hǎo le .
lines.en: Before leaving, he made sure all the windows were shut.

lines.zh: 我想确保每个人都有座位。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng què bǎo měi gè rén dōu yǒu zuò wèi .

lines.zh: 把杯子放远一点，防止被碰倒。

lines.zh: 她写了张纸条，防止自己忘记。
lines.py: tā xiě le zhāng zhǐ tiáo , fáng zhǐ zì jǐ wàng jì .
lines.en: She wrote herself a note to avoid forgetting.

lines.zh: 医生告诉我们怎样预防感冒。
lines.py: yī shēng gào sù wǒ men zěn yàng yù fáng gǎn mào .
lines.en: The doctor told us how to prevent colds.

lines.zh: 这次检查是为了预防机器故障。
lines.py: zhè cì jiǎn chá shì wèi le yù fáng jī qì gù zhàng .
lines.en: This inspection is to prevent machine faults.

lines.zh: 你先说说今天的情况。
lines.py: nǐ xiān shuō shuō jīn tiān de qíng kuàng .
lines.en: Tell me how things went today.

lines.zh: 我打电话问了他的情况。
lines.py: wǒ dǎ diàn huà wèn le tā de qíng kuàng .
lines.en: I called to ask how he was doing.

lines.zh: 她教我如何使用这个工具。
lines.py: tā jiào wǒ rú hé shǐ yòng zhè gè gōng jù .
lines.en: She taught me how to use this tool.

lines.zh: 我还不知道如何回答他。
lines.py: wǒ hái bù zhī dào rú hé huí dá tā .
lines.en: I still don't know how to answer him.

lines.zh: 你能不能帮我拿一下？
lines.py: nǐ néng bù néng bāng wǒ ná yī xià ?
lines.en: Could you help me carry this?

lines.zh: 我们能不能晚一点走？
lines.py: wǒ men néng bù néng wǎn yī diǎn zǒu ?
lines.en: Could we leave a little later?

2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: delivery and a wet bag; two friends catching up on a show; noodles with chilli served separately; friends admitting date mistakes. Corrected quilt/chair continuity: trousers move to the other chair, the old quilt joins them, and both are removed before the seat is free. Formal vocabulary uses independent contexts rather than speech that sounds like a report. Replaced abstract caution and assessment-policy dialogue. All target words get two independently authored contexts, and old word/task/unit IDs remain intact. Native flags: colloquial passive 叫, 具有 with formal collocations, 广大 in public notices, the playful eating invitation, 活 as vivid portrayal and 乐 lè as laughter.
